question: Determine which three lowest-level Reactome pathways (with TAS evidence) have the highest chi-squared statistics, considering only Homo sapiens targets associated with sorafenib under the conditions that the median assay value is ≤ 100 and both low and high assay values are ≤ 100 or null. For each of these three pathways, how many of these targets and non-targets lie within the pathway and outside it?
sql:
WITH 
-- Target physical entity stable IDs
target_pe AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT pe.stable_id
  FROM `isb-cgc-bq.reactome_versioned.physical_entity_v77` pe
  WHERE pe.uniprot_id IN (
    SELECT DISTINCT i.target_uniprotID
    FROM `isb-cgc-bq.targetome_versioned.interactions_v1` i
    JOIN `isb-cgc-bq.targetome_versioned.experiments_v1` e ON i.expID = e.expID
    JOIN `isb-cgc-bq.targetome_versioned.drug_synonyms_v1` ds ON i.drugID = ds.drugID
    WHERE ds.synonym = 'sorafenib'
      AND i.targetSpecies = 'Homo sapiens'
      AND e.exp_assayValueMedian <= 100
      AND (e.exp_assayValueLow <= 100 OR e.exp_assayValueLow IS NULL)
      AND (e.exp_assayValueHigh <= 100 OR e.exp_assayValueHigh IS NULL)
  )
),
-- Total counts
total_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM target_pe) as num_targets,
    (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT pe_to.pe_stable_id) FROM `isb-cgc-bq.reactome_versioned.pe_to_pathway_v77` pe_to WHERE pe_to.evidence_code = 'TAS') as total_pe
),
-- For each lowest-level pathway with TAS evidence, count targets and non-targets in it
pathway_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    p.stable_id as pathway_id,
    p.name as pathway_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN tp.stable_id IS NOT NULL THEN pe_to.pe_stable_id END) as targets_in,
    COUNT(DISTINCT pe_to.pe_stable_id) - COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN tp.stable_id IS NOT NULL THEN pe_to.pe_stable_id END) as non_targets_in
  FROM `isb-cgc-bq.reactome_versioned.pe_to_pathway_v77` pe_to
  JOIN `isb-cgc-bq.reactome_versioned.pathway_v77` p ON pe_to.pathway_stable_id = p.stable_id
  LEFT JOIN target_pe tp ON pe_to.pe_stable_id = tp.stable_id
  WHERE p.lowest_level = TRUE AND pe_to.evidence_code = 'TAS'
  GROUP BY p.stable_id, p.name
)
SELECT 
  pc.pathway_id,
  pc.pathway_name,
  ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(
    POWER((pc.targets_in * ((tc.total_pe - tc.num_targets) - pc.non_targets_in) - pc.non_targets_in * (tc.num_targets - pc.targets_in)), 2) * tc.total_pe,
    (pc.targets_in + pc.non_targets_in) * (tc.num_targets - pc.targets_in + tc.total_pe - tc.num_targets - pc.non_targets_in) * (pc.targets_in + tc.num_targets - pc.targets_in) * (pc.non_targets_in + tc.total_pe - tc.num_targets - pc.non_targets_in)
  ), 2) as chi_squared,
  pc.targets_in as targets_in_pathway,
  tc.num_targets - pc.targets_in as targets_out_pathway,
  pc.non_targets_in as non_targets_in_pathway,
  (tc.total_pe - tc.num_targets) - pc.non_targets_in as non_targets_out_pathway
FROM pathway_counts pc
CROSS JOIN total_counts tc
ORDER BY chi_squared DESC
LIMIT 3
